title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
abstract: arXiv:2611.33679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. translated_title: 更快更好的查询（FBQ）：从首个生成Token学习未来位置探测
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型（LLM）在预填充阶段结束时逐出提示词的键值缓存时，它必须在看到后续解码步骤的查询之前就决定保留哪些内容。生成草稿续写可以近似这些查询，但代价是需要额外的自回归步骤。我们能否利用首个输出token的嵌入——它已经可以从最后一次预填充的logits中获得——来构建低成本的伪查询，以近似未来的解码查询？我们从FTQ-8入手，该方法将首个token ID的八个副本放置在连续的未来位置上，并在一次因果前向传播中读取它们对提示词的注意力。每个副本会看到不同的前缀，但像"the"这样通用的开头对连续七个token的逐字猜测效果很差。Faster and Better Query（FBQ）保留了首个嵌入，并在其余七个位置的每一个上学习一个加性偏移。我们训练这些偏移来预测……的平均提示词注意力
tldr: 提出FBQ方法，通过保留首个生成token的嵌入并为其学习可加性偏移，仅用一次前向传播即可构建低成本伪查询来近似未来解码查询，从而无需额外自回归步骤就能更好地决定KV缓存的逐出策略。
en_tdlr: FBQ preserves the first generated token's embedding and learns additive offsets at future positions, constructing low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries in a single forward pass—enabling better KV cache eviction decisions without extra autoregressive steps.
